easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
